canDoEn: Say the cost, a percent off, and whether tax is included.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: How much does this piece cost, and is the tax already in that price?
dialogue.say: How much does this [[kˈɑst]] today, and is the tax already in that price?

dialogue.speaker: mei
dialogue.text: This piece is on sale today, so the price is lower than it was yesterday.
dialogue.glossYue: 呢件今日減價，所以平過尋日。
dialogue.say: This piece is on sale today, so the price is lower than it was yesterday.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Is there a discount if I take the ring and the chain too?
dialogue.glossYue: 如果我戒指同頸鏈一齊要，有冇折扣？
dialogue.say: Is there a discount if I take the ring and the chain too?

dialogue.speaker: mei
dialogue.text: Ten percent off, and tax is included, which makes the total much easier to see.
dialogue.glossYue: 九折，稅包咗，總數會清楚好多。
dialogue.say: Ten percent off, and tax is included, which makes the total much easier to see.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: That is within my budget, so I can take this one item home.
dialogue.glossYue: 呢個價錢喺我預算內，我可以攞呢件返去。
dialogue.say: That is within my budget, so I can take this one item home.

dialogue.speaker: mei
dialogue.text: This one is more expensive because the center stone is larger and clearer.
dialogue.glossYue: 呢件貴啲，因為中間粒石大啲同清楚啲。
dialogue.say: This one is more expensive because the center stone is larger and clearer.

dialogue.speaker: mei
dialogue.text: If you take both, the total is lower, and I can wrap them as one gift.
dialogue.glossYue: 如果你兩件一齊要，總數會平啲，我可以當一份禮包好。
dialogue.say: If you take both, the total is lower, and I can wrap them as one gift.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: That price is worth it, because the finish should last for many years.
dialogue.glossYue: 呢個價錢抵，因為個面可以耐好多年。
dialogue.say: That price is worth it, because the finish should last for many years.

dialogue.speaker: mei
dialogue.text: The total is a good deal, which is why many guests take both pieces.
dialogue.glossYue: 總數好抵，所以好多客人兩件一齊要。
dialogue.say: The total is a good deal, which is why many guests take both pieces.

understand.prompt: How much does this cost? 即係問緊咩？
Ten percent off, and tax is included. 呢句即係點？
understand.explain: off 係減。included 係包咗喺總數。

understand.prompt: within my budget 呢句即係點？
understand.explain: 預算係客人自己嘅上限。

chunks.pattern: How much does this ___ if the tax is already included today?
chunks.example: How much does this cost if the tax is already included today?

chunks.pattern: This piece is on ___ today, so the price is lower for you.
chunks.example: This piece is on sale today, so the price is lower for you.

chunks.pattern: The offer is ten percent ___ if you take both pieces today.
chunks.example: The offer is ten percent off if you take both pieces today.

chunks.pattern: That total is within my ___, so I can take the piece now.
chunks.example: That total is within my budget, so I can take the piece now.

shadow.hint: Ten percent off, and tax is included.

build.promptYue: Tom 問有冇折扣。你點講？
choices: Ten percent off, and tax is included.
build.explain: 講減幾多，再講稅包唔包。

roleplay.intro: Tom 問價錢。等佢講完先答。可以講：It comes to the total。

turns.expect: This piece is on sale today.
Ten percent off, and tax is included.
The total is a good deal.

quiz.prompt: 客人講「Is there a discount if I take the ring and the chain too?」，係咩意思？
客人講「That is within my budget, so I can take this one item home.」，係咩意思？

quiz.explain: sale 尾音係 /l/。discount 名詞重音喺第一節。

sound.title: 特價尾音
sound.note: sale 尾音係 /l/。舌尖抵住上顎後面，氣由兩邊出。discount 名詞重音喺第一節 /ˈdɪs.kaʊnt/。cost 讀 /ˈkɑst/，唔好讀成 /kɔst/。
